Owned synthetic fixtures: 32x32 solid red/blue, no third-party artwork.
Generated with ImageMagick 7; the repository license applies.
Run in this directory:

magick -size 32x32 xc:red -strip static.webp
magick -size 32x32 xc:red -strip static.gif
magick -size 32x32 xc:red -strip static.png
magick -size 32x32 xc:blue -strip static.jpg
magick -delay 40 -size 32x32 xc:red -delay 40 -size 32x32 xc:blue -loop 0 -strip animated.gif
magick -delay 40 -size 32x32 xc:red -delay 40 -size 32x32 xc:blue -loop 0 -strip animated.webp
